text: The Agile P15D is a dual-powered non-directional overcurrent and earth fault relay. It provides protection for applications where no external auxiliary power is available or the auxiliary supply does not guarantee the dependability required for protection applications. The relay is designed for MV/LV industrial installations, distribution network substations and more specifically in RMU networks for protection and monitoring purposes. It may also be applied for direct refurbishment of substations using older induction-disc IDMT overcurrent relays, as the P15D energizes from the line current transformers in the same way that the disc relay derived its operating power source from the CTs only.
heading: Feeder Protection

text: The main protection functions are timed and instantaneous phase and earth fault protection, with up to 3 independent stages available. Thermal overload, cold load pickup, inrush blocking and multiple setting groups add to the application capabilities of this versatile relay.
